title: Smoke Detector Beep
blurb: One high beep, then silence, then madness. The smoke detector low-battery chirp is the most psychologically hostile sound in any home: impossible to locate, impossible to ignore, and spaced at an interval just long enough that you begin doubting you heard it at all. Manufacturers built it that way so it cannot be tuned out, which makes it elite prank material. Play it near someone and watch them dismantle a ceiling. Deploy responsibly, because this one genuinely ruins evenings.
origin: The universal low-battery chirp of smoke detectors everywhere.
